Name: Cthulhu Custom NPC (Elliott Replacement Mod)
Author: synogi
Description:
[b]WORKING MOD[/b]
I am working on adding more features but the mod functions as a NPC mod and is tested before each release.
Please contact me if you encounter any bugs or any Elliott lines that make it through.

[center][b][size=3]About Cthulhu[/size][/b][/center]
Cthulhu is a mysterious and reclusive person who lives in the beach shack. There's just something off about him, but it seems normal in a valley with mermaids, shadow people, and a local wizard. He seems to enjoy weaving, sewing, going on adventures, and taking care of his unique plants.

Cthulhu is genderfluid, which means that they can be any gender, but for the purposes of gameplay he is default male. I will add a config option for female Cthulhu in the future. 

I recommend using PreganancyChoice and NPC Locations mod!
﻿
Cthulhu replaces Elliott because this is my first mod and I wanted to work off a base, and I needed his house. This also means that there may be some lines meant to be said by Elliott or in reference to Elliott I may have missed. I may consider making Cthulhu a standalone NPC in the future. 
Since he replaces an existing villager this mod should be compatible with most other mods. However there isn't much I can do for other mods that have dialogue in reference to Elliott.

[center][b][size=3]TROUBLESHOOTING[/size][/b][/center]
If you have a portrait mod, make sure the line:
  {
         "Action": "Load",
         "Target": "Portraits/Elliott",
         "FromFile": "assets/Elliott.png"
      },
AND
  {
         "Action": "Load",
         "Target": "Portraits/Elliott_Beach",
         "FromFile": "assets/Elliott_IslandSouth.png"
      },
AND
  {
          "Action": "Load",
          "Target": "Portraits/Elliott_Winter",
          "FromFile": "assets/Elliott_Winter.png"
       },
Are deleted from the content file for the Portrait Mod or Cthulhu's portraits will not load. 

Another option is to comment the lines out with a // at the beginning of each line.
Example:
 // {
 //        "Action": "Load",
 //        "Target": "Portraits/Elliott",
 //        "FromFile": "assets/Elliott.png"
 //     },
AND
 // {
 //        "Action": "Load",
 //        "Target": "Portraits/Elliott_Beach",
 //        "FromFile": "assets/Elliott_IslandSouth.png"
 //     },
AND
//  {
//          "Action": "Load",
//          "Target": "Portraits/Elliott_Winter",
//          "FromFile": "assets/Elliott_Winter.png"
//       },
This is so you may use Elliott's portraits later when you are not using the Cthulhu Mod. When you want use Elliott's portraits, simple delete the //
